cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government transfer, salary or pension is paid digitally in service; the 2024 CNAS-Algerie Poste convention sets up digital transfers, and the 2023 unemployment allowance paid into CCP accounts is older than three years.
cells.note: In June 2024 CNAS and Algerie Poste signed a convention to digitise transfers of social-insurance benefits to CCP accounts, a contracted digital payment, so stage 2. No source in the window says such payments are in service, so not 3.
